verdict.rationale: Stripe Connect's own docs say it can create a charge and split payments between the platform and sellers, automatically paying out a portion to sellers, which covers the core split-and-take-a-cut idea. The pack does not show splitting one charge across multiple sellers, reversing or adjusting a split later, or the split being modeled as first-class API objects. missing for 10: documented multi-party split of a single charge, transfer reversal/adjustment capability, explicit API objects for splits/transfers/application fees, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can split one charge among any set of parties — route funds to multiple sellers, take my cut, and reverse or adjust the split later, all as first-class API objects

citations.quote: Create a charge and split payments between your platform and your sellers or service providers.
Collect payments from customers and automatically pay out a portion to sellers or service providers on your marketplace.
